However, each and every member of the consortium shall be equally responsible for the complete execution of the project contract. An undertaking to this effect is to be uploaded with bid. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of THE DIG MEDICAL CH CRPF PUNE MAHARASHTRA payable at THE DIG MEDICAL CH CRPF PUNE MAHARASHTRA . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) for Collection of Biomedical Waste 01. Statutory Compliances & Licenses (Mandatory Documents) :- ● MPCB/SPCB Authorization: The bidder must possess a valid authorization from the State Pollution Control Board (e.g., MPCB for Maharashtra) under the Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016 (and its amend ments) for the collection, transportation, treatment, and disposal of biomedical waste. ● CTEF Facility Linkage: The bidder must have a valid agreement or ownership proof of a Common Bio-Me dical Waste Treatment Facility (CBWTF) authorized by the State Pollution Control Board.

● Vehicle Fitness: All vehicles used for the transportation of biomedical waste must be GPS-enabled and co mpliance-certified by the State Pollution Control Board and Regional Transport Office (RTO) specifically for carrying hazardous/biomedical waste. 02. Operational & Service Delivery Guidelines: - ● Timely Collection: The service provider must collect biomedical waste daily/alternatively (as specified by the buyer) within the designated time slot. Waste must not be stored at the hospital premises beyond 48 h ours under any circumstance. ● Barcoded Bag System: The bidder must provide a Barcoded Bag/Container tracking system as per Centr al Pollution Control Board (CPCB) guidelines to log the weight and category of waste at the time of collectio n. ● Segregation & Colour Coding: The bidder will accept waste strictly segregated into color-coded bags (Ye llow, Red, White, Blue) as per BMW Rules 2016. Any mis-segregated waste must be immediately reported to the hospital management. 3. Manpower & Safety Protocol :- ● PPE Kits: The bidder’s staff handling the waste must wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PP E) including heavy-duty gloves, masks, aprons, and safety boots. ● Immunization Record: The service provider must submit proof of immunization (Hepatitis B and Tetanus) for all personnel deployed for waste handling and transportation. 4. Financial & Legal Terms :- ● Turnover & Experience: The bidder must have at least last three years of experience in providing Biome dical Waste Management services to government hospitals/private medical institutions. Audited balance s heets for the last 3 financial years must be submitted. ● Billing Basis: Payment will be processed on a Quarterly basis based on the actual weight recorded via th e barcode system or per-bed basis (as chosen in the financial bid), duly certified by the hospital’s Nodal Officer/In-charge. ● Liquidated Damages / Penalty Clause: ● Failure to collect waste on a scheduled day will attract a penalty of Rs. 2000/- per day. ● Any fine imposed by the Pollution Control Board due to negligence or non-compliance by the bidder will be entirely borne by the service provider. 5. Performance Security: - · The successful bidders will be informed whereupon performance security is to be furnished by successful bidders to an amount of 3 percent of the Bid value. Performance security should be furnished in the form o f account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt (Certificate). Banker’s cheque of Bank Guarantee in favour of The DIG (Medical) Composite Hospital CRPF Pune, Pin Code-410507. Performance security shoul d remain valid for a period of 14 months beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations by th e supplier. 5. Termination of Contract :- ● The buyer (Hospital/Institution) reserves the right to terminate the contract immediately without any pri or notice if the bidder's SPCB/CPCB license is cancelled, suspended, or expires during the contract period. .
